description: Send LinkHatch an order or request. We email the owner of `email` a link to confirm it (status awaiting_confirmation); nothing is placed, charged or sent to anyone until they press Confirm. After that, we reply to that address with the site shortlist for approval or a quote, and monthly plans go straight to Stripe checkout. Confirm the details with your user before calling, and tell them to look for the email.

addons.description: Monthly plans only. outreach = Relationship outreach: genuine article swaps; each live earned link uses plan credits by site tier (2 Standard, 3 Plus, 5 Premium), no extra fee, no fixed link count.

agent_name.description: Name of the agent placing the order.

competitors.description: Two or more competitor domains, comma separated.

content_item.description: kind=content only. article = one-off, set quantity (1 to 20); content-package = monthly, 5 articles.

credits.description: Agency plan only: credits a month (10+, $135 each at 25+).

email.description: Contact email for the human who owns the order. We reply here.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse it when retrying the same order so the owner gets one confirmation email, not two.

kind.description: audit = free link plan (pages to push, competitor links you lack, costs); plan = monthly credit plan (plans only: LinkHatch does not sell single links, the smallest plan is Starter, 5 links a month); content = content writing ($250 an article up to 1,500 words, or the $1,250 monthly package of 5); pr = PR item; outreach = cold email campaign; quote = anything else

on_behalf_of.description: Person or company the agent acts for.

site.description: Domain to build links to (required for audit and plan).

target_pages.description: Pages the links should point to.

name: place_order
title: Place an order or request
